svg.title: What is a virtual item worth?
svg.desc: Daily CS:GO Weapon Case (1) prices in U.S. dollars and trading volume on a logarithmic scale, September 1, 2013 to April 30, 2025. The highest price in the series is $136.711 on February 17, 2025. All 4,260 observations from the supplied chart are retained. Source: charts.pptx, slide 3, embedded charts 5 and 6. Market data from Valve, as cited in Christian J. Heinze’s master’s thesis.

g.text: What is a virtual item worth?
Source: Steam Community Market / Valve · Master’s thesis, Christian J. Heinze
